newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet falls with NYMEX, but diffs firm.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet falls with NYMEX, but diffs firm.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices fell sharply late Wednesday, players said, with a 1.40 cent drop in April NYMEX futures outweighing moderately firmer differentials.
Prompt USG front-10th-cycle 54-grade fuel was sold for 0.75 cent above the May print, 0.40 cent firmer than Tuesday diffs, with traders ascribing the boost to buying by Mobil, Coastal and Fina.

"It's a thin market, so a few buyers can spook differentials higher," one Gulf player said, who added the market seemed well supplied. He noted that API data released Tuesday showed jet fuel stocks risng 1.2 million barrels for the prior week.
Low-sulfur Gulf 55-grade was sold for 1.0 cent and 1.25 cents over the May print, about a half cent firmer than Tuesday diffs, players added.
New York 54-grade diffs were pulled 0.25-cent higher by Gulf strength, traders said, with offers at about 2.50 cents above the April screen.
((- Ransdell Pierson, New York Energy Desk, 212 859-1632))
